battle.name: 洛南之戰
battle.brief: 隋大業十四年（618）正月，瓦崗軍在洛口倉洛水之南，與王世充隔河相持。正月十五日王世充造浮橋強渡，攻破瓦崗軍外柵，李密以敢死隊反擊，隋軍爭相過橋，死者萬餘人，王世充奔河陽。瓦崗軍乘勝取金墉城，兵眾達三十萬，進逼上春門。卡面秦連弩為隔河弩射的技術源頭，浮橋無遮蔽，最忌弩箭居高覆蓋。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰雙方是隋朝東都留守軍與李密領導的瓦崗軍。隋軍由江都通守王世充總領，兵源包含京師宿衛、畿輔府兵與東都城防部隊，正月又得東都七萬援軍補充，麾下有虎賁郎將王辯等將領，攻城與野戰裝備齊備；東都朝廷以越王楊侗居尊，太府卿與御史大夫分掌政務，王世充握有兵柄，權傾一方，名義上仍奉隋室正朔。瓦崗軍則是李密以翟讓部眾為骨幹整合而成的流民聯軍，建元永平、號魏，李密自稱魏公兼行軍大都督，以洛口倉為根據地，實行屯田、按部給糧與賞格召募，部眾以重賞驅使，常設敢死隊。戰線上，瓦崗軍占據洛水以南的洛口倉與金墉城，隋軍控制洛水以北的鞏縣，並屯兵含嘉城，隔河相望。雙方弓箭人手皆多，隋軍以騎兵與虎賲武卒為精銳，瓦崗軍則以步卒列陣，兩軍糧秣皆仰洛口倉與江淮一路徵發。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Sui garrison of the Eastern Capital and the Wagang army of Li Mi. The Sui force was commanded as a whole by Wang Shichong, the Tongshou (military governor) of Jiangdu; its strength drew on the palace guards of the capital, the metropolitan fubing of the imperial region, and the city troops of Luoyang, and in the first month it was reinforced by seventy thousand men sent out of the Eastern Capital. Under his command stood generals such as the Huben langjiang, commander of the tiger-clad guard, Wang Bian, and the siege and field equipment was complete. At court in the Eastern Capital the Prince of Yue, Yang Tong, held the throne, with the Taifuqing and the imperial censors dividing up the civil administration; Wang Shichong held the military power and dominated that court, yet still publicly obeyed the Sui in form. The Wagang army was a coalition of refugees and rebels that Li Mi welded together around the surviving followers of Zhai Rang; it proclaimed the Yongping era and the state of Wei, with Li Mi styling himself Duke of Wei and acting grand commander. It used the granary complex of Luokou as its base, with tuntian farming, grain issued by unit, and rewards offered for recruits, its ranks driven on by heavy payment and with dare-to-die units kept in the line. On the line of contact the Wagang held the south bank of the Luo River around Luokou and the walled town of Jinyong, while the Sui held the north bank at Gongxian and camped at Hanjia City; the two faced each other across the water. Both sides had many archers; the Sui relied on cavalry and on the tiger-clad guard as their elite, while the Wagang formed up their infantry, and both drew their grain from Luokou and from requisitions along the Jianghuai.
people: 瓦崗一方以李密為核心。李密字法主，襄城人，早年曾在洛陽做過小吏，後投翟讓，勸其歸隋受官；及瓦崗軍破洛口倉、聲勢大盛，李密殺翟讓、盡併其眾，自居帥位，設計定策、壓制部眾，因此既得眾心也結下怨讎。將佐之中，房彥藻最長於攻城，617年即率軍攻下洛陽城東的金墉城，韋津出戰陣亡、段達宵遁；邴元真掌糧械支應。隋軍一方，王世充出身略陽，久在江都、洛陽之間效力，對李密屢戰屢勝，一度逼得瓦崗軍退守，此役卻是他的敗績；虎賲郎將王辯是浮橋攻擊的先鋒，戰歿於橋南。隋朝另出金紫光祿大夫段達、民部尚書韋津出城抵禦。東都的越王楊侗在王世充敗亡之後不但不加罪責，反而赦免其罪、召還東都、賜第與美女，以安軍心。
peopleEn: The Wagang side was built around Li Mi. Li Mi, courtesy name Fazhu, was a native of Xiangcheng; he began as a minor clerk at Luoyang, later joined Zhai Rang, and urged him to submit to the Sui and take office, yet after the Wagang army took Luokou and its prestige swelled he killed Zhai Rang, absorbed his followers wholesale and made himself sole commander, and by taking charge of strategy and crushing the old leaders he won the loyalty of the rank and file while also making enemies among them. Among his commanders Fang Yan'ao was the most skilled at siege work: in 617 he had already stormed the walled town of Jinyong east of Luoyang, where Wei Jin was killed in action and Dan Da fled by night; Bing Yuanzhen handled grain and equipment. On the Sui side, Wang Shichong came from Lueyang and had long served between Jiangdu and Luoyang, winning repeated victories over Li Mi and once driving the Wagang back onto the defensive, and this campaign was his defeat. Wang Bian, the Huben langjiang, led the assault across the floating bridge and was killed south of it. The Sui also sent out the Grand Master of the Golden Purple Splendour Dignity, Dan Da, and the Minister of Revenue, Wei Jin, to meet the rebels. The Prince of Yue, Yang Tong, after Wang Shichong's defeat not only forgave him but summoned him back to the Eastern Capital and bestowed a mansion and women to steady his spirits.
kits: 卡面兵器是秦連弩，即秦代重弩機：弩機以木臂承力、青銅機件蓄弦，觸發卮機，一踩一發，可連珠射出，是弩機技術的源頭。它出現在這場戰鬥的方式並非原物照搬到隋末，而是作為技術譜系的源頭——從秦弩到漢代趙過改進的連射弩機、曹魏諸葛弩一類的機弩，再到隋唐通行的步弩、擘張弩與角弓弩，一脈相承的是「把拉力存起來、一次踩下放一發」的原理。洛南之戰的戰場上，弩是兩岸都離不開的東西：隋軍在洛水北岸以弩控制渡口與浮橋頭，瓦崗軍在柵內以步弩齊射掩護敢死隊突進，浮橋上人馬無遮蔽，正面吃滿弩箭最為致命。除弩外，隋軍還有槊、方盾、拒馬與騎兵，瓦崗軍則以長槍、大盾、砍刀與步卒為主，並靠洛口倉供應矢石與糧秣。攻城用的樓車、巢車與投石機在此役未見記載，但常備於隋軍的攻城序列之中。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Qin repeating crossbow, that is the heavy crossbow mechanism of the Qin: the wooden arm carries the load while bronze fittings store the drawn string, and a trigger lever lets one stored shot follow another by pressure of the foot, which makes it the ancestor of crossbow technology. Its presence in this campaign is not a transplant of the original artefact into the late Sui period but rather the head of a lineage. From the Qin crossbow to the rapid-firing mechanism improved under Han, to the machine crossbows of the Cao Wei period such as the Zhuge crossbow, and on to the walking crossbow, the bar-drawn crossbow and the horn bow crossbow in ordinary Sui and Tang service, what carries through unchanged is the principle of storing the pull and releasing it with a single stroke of the foot. In the fighting at Luonan the crossbow was something neither bank could do without. The Sui used crossbows on the north bank of the Luo to cover the crossing point and the head of the floating bridge, while the Wagang used walking crossbows inside the palisade to deliver massed volleys covering the assault of their dare-to-die unit; a bridge crowded with men has no cover at all and suffers most cruelly under crossbow fire. Besides the crossbows, the Sui carried spears, square shields, caltrops and cavalry, while the Wagang relied on long spears, large shields, sabres and infantry, drawing arrows, stones and grain out of Luokou. Siege towers, scaling towers and stone-throwers are not recorded as taking part here, though they stood ready in the Sui siege train.
tactics: 此役的關鍵在洛水這道天險與一座浮橋。隋軍屯兵洛水北岸，無法從正面強渡，乃令諸軍並行造浮橋，試圖以橋頭展開兵力直取南岸；然而造橋各部缺乏統一指揮，橋成一段便各自投入攻擊，前隊既無接應、亦無遮蔽，陣形很快被瓦崗軍外柵截斷。虎賲郎將王辯攻破外柵，瓦崗軍營中驚亂，幾欲崩潰；王世充不諳戰況，鳴號收兵，號角之令反使隋軍失去攻勢，李密趁隙整飭行列，以敢死隊自柵縫反擊。橋上人群密集，進退無路，隋軍大潰，爭相渡橋，死者萬餘。夜間隋軍再涉黃河至河陽，風雨交加，士卒凍斃者以萬計。次日李密追擊段達、韋津的潰兵，隋軍望風奔散；瓦崗軍乘勝取金墉城，陳兵北邙山，進逼上春門。弩手在此役的角色很清楚：居高臨下、以射速覆蓋渡口者勝，浮橋則是最差的射界。
tacticsEn: The crux of this campaign was the natural barrier of the Luo River and a single floating bridge. The Sui held the north bank and could not force a crossing on the front, so they had their units build a bridge of boats in parallel and try to deploy their strength from the bridgehead against the south bank. But the units building it had no unified command, and as each stretch was finished they threw themselves into the assault in turn; the leading files received neither support nor cover, and their line was quickly cut at the Wagang outer fence. Wang Bian broke the fence, and the Wagang camp fell into confusion, on the point of collapsing. Wang Shichong, unaware of the state of the fight, sounded the horns to call the troops in, and that signal cost the Sui the initiative, while Li Mi used the moment to restore his line and strike back through a gap in the fence with his dare-to-die unit. The bridge was packed with men who had nowhere to advance and nowhere to retreat; the Sui broke, all rushed to cross, and more than ten thousand died. That night the fugitives forded the Yellow River towards Heyang, and in wind and rain the men froze to death by the tens of thousands. The next day Li Mi pursued the routed troops of Dan Da and Wei Jin, and the Sui scattered at the sight of them. The Wagang took Jinyong, deployed along the northern slope of Mount Mang, and pressed up to the Shangchun Gate. The role of the crossbow in all this is plain: he who shoots from above and covers the crossing with rate of fire wins, and a floating bridge is the worst place on earth to stand for that fire.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾處：隋軍正月得東都七萬援軍，說明東都方面仍握有可抽調的兵員儲備；正月十五日浮橋之戰，隋軍死者萬餘人，虎賲郎將王辯等六員大將陣亡；敗軍夜渡河陽，士卒凍死者以萬計；王世充收攏散卒，得萬餘人屯於含嘉城，暫時不敢再出；瓦崗軍則乘勝擴張，義眾迅速發展到三十萬人，兵佈在北邙山一線，偃師、柏谷、河陽等地的隋將紛紛率部降。地理與物資方面，洛口倉在鞏縣東北、洛水南岸，與東都洛陽相隔數十里水道，倉儲糧秣極豐，正是瓦崗軍能養活數十萬眾並供應矢石的依據；洛水則是這條補給線的天然護城。史籍對全役的總兵力、俘虜數、器械損耗皆無記載，弩的規格與射程同樣沒有確數，只能按當時步弩、擘張弩的常規推想。年份方面，李密建魏改元永平二年，與隋大業十四年、隋恭帝義寧二年並列，三個年號同時並行，正見隋室在名義上的分裂。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked cluster in a few places. The Sui received seventy thousand reinforcements from the Eastern Capital in the first month, which shows the capital still had troops it could strip and send out. In the fight over the floating bridge on the fifteenth day of the first month, more than ten thousand Sui soldiers died and six senior generals including Wang Bian were killed. The beaten army crossed the river to Heyang by night and men froze to death by the tens of thousands. Wang Shichong gathered the survivors, made up a little more than ten thousand men, and camped at Hanjia City, unwilling to sortie. The Wagang, meanwhile, expanded as they won, the rebel host growing rapidly to three hundred thousand men deployed along the northern side of Mount Mang, and the Sui commanders at Yanshi, Baigu and Heyang surrendered with their troops in turn. Geographically, Luokou lay north-east of Gongxian on the south bank of the Luo, a few tens of li of water from the Eastern Capital at Luoyang, and its stores of grain were immense; it was the basis on which the Wagang could feed tens of thousands of men and supply arrows and stones. The Luo itself was the natural moat guarding that supply line. No record gives the total strength on either side, the number of prisoners, or the loss of equipment, and the specifications and range of the crossbows are equally unrecorded; they can only be inferred from the ordinary walking and bar-drawn crossbows of the time. On the dating, Li Mi's Wei counted the second year of Yongping, which runs alongside the fourteenth year of Daye and the second year of Yining under Emperor Gong of the Sui; three reign titles were in use at once, which is exactly what the split of the Sui in name looked like.
cause: 大業年間的三征高句麗耗空了人力與財貨，天下群雄並起，隋室在名義上分作兩截：長安奉越王楊侗的恭帝，年號義寧，江都的煬帝另立大業十四年，各州郡將領各擁所主，徵集兵馬不再問朝廷。洛陽與洛口倉一帶是天下漕運的轉軸，倉中糧秣兵械堆積如山，誰控制這一帶，誰就控制東都周邊的兵源與食源。李密自憑洛口倉起兵，破金墉城、威脅洛陽，兵眾已逾三十萬，便以取洛陽、進圖天下為志；東都朝堂則因李密逼近而驚惶，任用王世充主持東線兵事。隋末的洛陽本已內疲：賦役、兵禍、饑饉三重壓力之下，府兵制下的守軍缺額嚴重、器械朽壞，能倚靠的只有王世充新得的外援與洛水天險。王世充因此在正月主動出擊，企圖在瓦崗軍立足未穩、外柵未固時將其趕回洛口倉一線，重新拉開距離。
causeEn: The three campaigns against Goguryeo in the Daye years drained the empire of manpower and wealth, and warlords rose everywhere. The Sui now existed in name in two halves: Chang'an served the Prince of Yue Yang Tong as Emperor Gong under the Yining era, while at Jiangdu the Emperor Yang kept a separate reign title of the fourteenth year of Daye, and the commanders of the various prefectures each followed one ruler or another and raised troops without troubling the court. Luoyang and the district of Luokou were the pivot of the empire's grain transport, where grain and weapons were piled up; whoever held that ground controlled the manpower and the food supply around the Eastern Capital. Li Mi had raised his men on the strength of Luokou, stormed Jinyong and threatened Luoyang with more than three hundred thousand men, and set his sights on taking Luoyang and then the empire. The court of the Eastern Capital, alarmed by his approach, put Wang Shichong in charge of the eastern front. Luoyang was exhausted in any case: levies, war and famine together had left the defenders short in numbers and their equipment rotten, so that only the reinforcements Wang Shichong had just received and the barrier of the Luo could be relied upon. Hence in the first month he took the offensive, hoping to drive the Wagang back towards Luokou while their new position was not yet secure and their outer fence not yet firm.
impact: 洛南之戰是隋末最要緊的樞紐之一。此戰之後，洛陽以北盡入瓦崗軍之手，東都人心震動，江淮一帶的起義軍爭先恐後歸附李密，瓦崗軍的聲勢達到頂點，也把李密推到與河北竇建德、太原劉武周、江東杜伏威等群雄同一層級；唐高祖李淵於同年十一月建唐，長安新立，李密的魏政權與洛陽的隋室殘餘同時成為新朝必須解決的對象。其直接結果是李密得以集中兵力經營東都，讓李世民得以在621年先後平定竇建德與劉武周，而不必兩面受敵。技術層面上，此役也留下一次真實的示範：跨越水障的進攻必須有浮橋、有齊射掩護、有敢死隊的反擊，而當統帥對戰況失去把握、號令失序時，再厚的兵力也會潰於一旦。李密的巔峰短促，619年他降唐，隨即起兵反唐被殺，瓦崗軍建制隨之瓦解；洛陽則仍由王世充守到621年才開城降唐，成為唐朝統一的中樞。
impactEn: The battle of Luonan was one of the decisive hinges of the late Sui. After it everything north of the Luo at Luoyang fell to the Wagang, the Eastern Capital was shaken, and insurgents across the Jianghuai region flocked to Li Mi in quick succession, bringing the Wagang to the height of its power and placing Li Mi on the same level as Dou Jiande in the north, Liu Wuzhou at Taiyuan and Du Fuwei in the Jiangdong. In the eleventh month of the same year Li Yuan founded the Tang at Chang'an, and the Wei regime of Li Mi and the last Sui remnants at Luoyang both became objects the new dynasty had to settle. The immediate effect was to let Li Mi concentrate his strength on the Eastern Capital, so that Li Shimin could deal first with Dou Jiande and with Liu Wuzhou in 621 without fighting on two fronts. At the level of technique the campaign also furnished a plain demonstration: an assault across a water barrier needs a bridge of boats, massed covering fire, and a counter-stroke by a forlorn hope, and when a commander has lost touch with the battle and the signals fall out of order, however thick the ranks are they will break in a moment. Li Mi's peak was brief; he surrendered to the Tang in 619, rose against it and was killed, and the Wagang organisation dissolved with him, while Luoyang, still held by Wang Shichong, did not open its gates to the Tang until 621, when it became the hinge of Tang unification.
result: 浮橋之戰以隋軍的崩潰告終。王辯等六將戰歿，隋軍死者萬餘，北岸全線潰散；王世充不敢回東都，帶殘部夜奔河陽，途中風雨致凍斃者以萬計，收攏散卒後僅得萬餘人，屯含嘉城，閉門不出。瓦崗軍隨即占領洛水以北的殘餘據點，李密乘勝追擊段達與韋津的兵眾，段達見李密勢盛而怯陣先退，隋軍望風而潰，偃師、柏谷、河陽等地的守將紛紛率部投降，江淮義軍隨之響應。瓦崗軍占據金墉城，兵眾達三十萬，陳兵北邙山，南望上春門，東都洛陽的城防壓力空前。但此役終究只是解除了洛陽外圍的威脅：李密未能攻破洛陽本城，糧秣、攻城器械與守軍的消耗拖住了腳步；洛陽最後由王世充守到621年，在唐軍的長期圍攻下開城投降。此役一過，隋朝在河南的野戰主力盡失，東都只剩城防與若干守將，再無能力主動出擊。
resultEn: The fight over the floating bridge ended in the collapse of the Sui. Wang Bian and five other generals were killed, more than ten thousand Sui died, and the whole north bank fell apart. Wang Shichong dared not return to the Eastern Capital, and with the remnant of his force ran by night to Heyang, where wind and rain killed further tens of thousands by freezing; gathering the survivors he had only a little over ten thousand men, camped at Hanjia City and kept his gates shut. The Wagang then occupied the remaining Sui positions on the north bank, and pressing the troops of Dan Da and Wei Jin, Li Mi saw Dan Da flinch at the sight of his masses and pull back first, the Sui scattering as they ran; the commanders at Yanshi, Baigu and Heyang surrendered with their troops, and insurgents across the Jianghuai followed. The Wagang occupied Jinyong, its host reached three hundred thousand, it deployed along Mount Mang and looked south towards the Shangchun Gate, and the pressure on the defences of Luoyang became unprecedented. Even so the campaign only removed the threat outside the city: Li Mi failed to breach Luoyang itself, and the drain of grain, siege equipment and garrison kept him at bay. Luoyang was held by Wang Shichong until 621, when it surrendered to the Tang after a long siege. With that battle done, the Sui lost its field army in Henan; the Eastern Capital was left with nothing but its walls and a handful of garrison commanders, unable to take the offensive again.
